title: 第一千六百六十四章 人跑了第一千六百六十三章 再入不周灵山
slug: 大道神主第一千六百七十二章妖人
content_zh:
第一千六百六十四章人跑了
萧叶停止了九黎壶的炼化，看着这混沌般的空间河流，有着一个灵祸妖的身影直接显露而出。
比起外面的那些灵祸妖，眼前的这个似乎要更加的纯粹一些，没有什么特别的外貌，看上去就如同一个简易的泥人，也没有上颜色般的朴素简单。
“人类，你需要留下你的命！”看着自己栖息的地方被炼化走了这般之多的能量，灵祸妖无比的愤怒。它能够诞生，能够修炼得如此之快，这里的环境功不可没，现在少了这么多能量，价值大打折扣。
它现在能够做的，那就是把萧叶封印在这里，利用萧叶的生命能量来弥补。
“真麻烦。”萧叶无奈的说道，遇到了一个九阶的灵祸妖，还是特殊诞生下来的，动起手来真的需要费一番功夫。
最重要的是...他害怕这类还有哪些阴沟的老鼠，哪些东西无处不在，自己又是其眼中钉，很可能早就洞察了他的动向，早就开始最准备，只待寻找一个恰当的时机。
突然，那灵祸妖身影消失在原地，直接来到了萧叶的身后。
萧叶仿佛是身后张了眼睛一般，身体本能的躲避，并给予了反击。
砰！
灵祸妖身体朝着上空飞出，更是撞碎了不少的空间结晶体。灵祸妖有些不可思议的看着萧叶，它想不明白，自己的身体能够灵化，对方是怎么打中自己的？
咻！
一道月刃沿着脖颈划过，乳白色的血液从脖子那里流淌而出。灵祸妖看着萧叶，眼神中满是杀意，还有一些震惊。
这里的环境，似乎没有给予半分的影响，空间法则的修士不是没有来过这里的，可多多少少都是有些影响的，但萧叶这般的...还真是少数，至少这是它第一次碰到。
影响什么的还是有的，至少萧叶在这里，也是难以维持界域的，这确实是很大的影响。
空间挤压而来，这里的空间好似一张长满了无数尖牙的嘴巴，用力的咬合下来。萧叶甚至于没有多看一眼，周围的空间之力膨胀，那咬下来的嘴巴直接被强行撬开。
从这一下，灵祸妖也感觉到了萧叶的强大，不由的开始心惊起来。
一个后天修炼空间法则的人类修士，竟然在空间法则的造诣上，逐渐有种要压制它这个天生就出生在空间法则浓厚的环境下的生灵，这简直不可思议。
“空间立场！”
萧叶调动周身灵力，直接改变了这里的空间构造，原本独属于灵祸妖的生存空间，仿佛变成了萧叶的掌中玩物。

拳脚，剑气，亦或是各种的法则攻击手段，从四面八方，各种不同的位置出现。招招朝着它的生命而来，若非是灵祸妖，若非这是出生之地，真的就被萧叶这一连串的攻击打得连灰都不剩。
“该死的人类，你太放肆了！”灵祸妖有些恼火，狂暴的灵力瞬间爆发而出，萧叶的立方体直接被震碎，这倒是让萧叶多看了这灵祸妖两眼，但也就是多看两眼。
九阶而已，一个空间产物，危险程度尚不如虚空巨兽。
而且，因为环境原因出不去，灵祸妖比起其余的妖兽，它们所能动用的法则之力也唯有空间之力，除此之外就再也没有其余的法则力量了。
当然作为妖兽，灵祸妖有着灵化的身体，强度上则是和人族差不多的。
面对那些空间造诣不高的修士，借助天然环境的优势自然能够占据优势。可面对萧叶这种，空间和时间造诣都相当高的对手，可谓是遇到了上头。
金色的火焰燃烧而起，周围的空间，在这金色火焰直接焚烧殆尽。
这个灵祸妖的灵化之体，在这金色火焰之下也是无法规避。
这是超越了它的法则之上，更加强大的法则之力。
萧叶看着灵祸妖，这东西显然不会动用界法。也是，这里的环境，界法确实难以调动，可萧叶调动的则是九黎壶小世界的力量，虽然不足以支撑，可也足够了。
灵祸妖咬牙切齿，身影消失，萧叶想要拦截却被突破了。
灵祸妖直接潜入到那下方的空间河流当中，萧叶都不敢下去去追，只是把九黎壶拿出来，开始炼化这里的力量。
虽然不知道那灵祸妖要做什么，但是这里的法则降低，力量变弱，对自己一定是有利，对对方一定是有弊的就行了。
“该死的，这个人类太不要脸了！世界上怎么会有如此卑鄙的人类！”
灵祸妖骂道，只能说这么一个单纯的妖兽，没有见到过人类的鬼点子，那点脑子放在人类世界里根本就不够用。
“等我吃饱了，看我出去以后把你当做肥料！”
就这样，一个在外面炼化力量，一个在里面吸收力量，相互直接开始争夺这里本就不多的能量了。
不久。
灵祸妖终于是汲取到了足够的能量，从那空间河流中飞出来。
因为萧叶的炼化，灵祸妖的汲取，那原本相当宽的河流，直接缩小了一半以上。这一半，没有数万年的时间，根本就恢复不过来，就这还要看运气。

灵祸妖要报仇，要吃了萧叶，可左眼一拳右看一圈，连个鬼影子都没看到。

Chapter 1664: People ran away
Xiao Ye stopped refining the Jiuli Pot and looked at the chaotic space river, with the figure of a spiritual disaster demon directly revealed.
Compared with the spiritual disaster monsters outside, the one in front of me seems to be purer. It has no special appearance. It looks like a simple clay figurine, and it is not as simple as coloring.
"Human, you need to save your life!" Seeing that so much energy has been refined away from the place where he lives, the spirit disaster demon is extremely angry. It was able to be born and cultivated so quickly because of the environment here. Now that it has lost so much energy, its value has been greatly reduced.
What it can do now is to seal Xiao Ye here and use Xiao Ye's life energy to make up for it.
"It's really troublesome." Xiao Ye said helplessly. He encountered a ninth-level spiritual disaster monster, which was born in a special way. It really took a lot of effort to get started.
The most important thing is... he is afraid of these kind of sewer rats, which are everywhere, and he is a thorn in their side. It is very likely that he has seen his movements and started to prepare for them long ago, just waiting to find the right time.
Suddenly, the figure of the spirit disaster demon disappeared from the place and came directly behind Xiao Ye.
Xiao Ye seemed to have opened his eyes behind him, his body instinctively avoided and counterattacked.
Bang!
The body of the Spiritual Disaster Demon flew upwards, shattering many space crystals. The Spiritual Disaster Demon looked at Xiao Ye in disbelief. It couldn't understand how the other party could hit it if its own body could be transformed into a spirit?
call out!
A moon blade slashed along the neck, and milky white blood flowed from the neck. The Spiritual Disaster Demon looked at Xiao Ye, his eyes full of murderous intent and a little shocked.
The environment here does not seem to have any influence at all. It is not that the monks of Space Law have never been here before, but they have some influence, but Xiao Ye's... are really rare, at least this is the first time it has encountered it.
There is still some influence, at least Xiao Ye is here, it is difficult to maintain the boundary, this is indeed a big influence.
The space is squeezed in. The space here is like a mouth filled with countless fangs, biting down hard. Xiao Ye didn't even take another look. The power of the surrounding space expanded, and the bitten mouth was forced open.
From this point on, the Spiritual Disaster Demon also felt how powerful Xiao Ye was, and couldn't help but start to feel frightened.
It is simply unbelievable that a human monk who has acquired the law of space has gradually developed the desire to suppress a creature that was born in an environment where the law of space is strong.
"Space stance!"
Xiao Ye mobilized his spiritual power and directly changed the spatial structure here. The living space that originally belonged to the Spiritual Disaster Demon seemed to have become a plaything in Xiao Ye's palm.
Fists, kicks, sword energy, or various legal attack methods appeared from all directions and from various positions. Zhaozhao came towards its life. If it wasn't a spiritual disaster monster, if it wasn't the place of birth, it would have been beaten to ashes by Xiao Ye's series of attacks.
"Damn human, you are too presumptuous!" The Spiritual Disaster Demon was a little annoyed. The violent spiritual power burst out instantly, and Xiao Ye's cube was directly shattered. This made Xiao Ye look at the Spiritual Disaster Demon twice more, but it was just a second glance.
It's only the ninth level, a product of space, not as dangerous as the giant beast of the void.
Moreover, due to environmental reasons, they cannot get out. Compared with other monsters, the only power of law they can use is the power of space. Apart from this, there is no other power of law.
Of course, as a monster, the spirit disaster monster has a spiritual body, and its strength is similar to that of the human race.
Facing those monks who do not have high spatial attainments, they can naturally gain an advantage by taking advantage of the natural environment.. But facing an opponent like Xiao Ye, who has very high attainments in space and time, it can be said that he has met a superior.
Golden flames burned, and the surrounding space was directly burned by the golden flames.
The spiritual body of this spiritual disaster demon cannot be avoided under this golden flame.
This is a more powerful power of law that transcends its laws.
Xiao Ye looked at the Spiritual Disaster Demon. This thing obviously couldn't use realm magic. Also, in the environment here, it is indeed difficult to mobilize the boundary law, but what Xiao Ye mobilized was the power of the small world of Jiulihu. Although it was not enough to support it, it was enough.
The Spiritual Disaster Demon gnashed its teeth and disappeared. Xiao Ye tried to intercept but was defeated.
The Spiritual Disaster Demon dived directly into the space river below. Xiao Ye didn't dare to chase it. He just took out the Jiuli Pot and began to refine the power here.
Although I don’t know what the spiritual disaster demon is going to do, the laws here are lowered and the power is weakened. It must be beneficial to myself and harmful to the other party.
"Damn, this human being is so shameless! How can there be such a despicable human being in the world!"
The Spiritual Disaster Demon cursed, it can only be said that such a simple monster has never seen any clever ideas from humans, and that little brain is simply not enough in the human world.
"When I'm full, watch me use you as fertilizer when I go out!"
In this way, one is refining power outside, and the other is absorbing power inside, and they directly start competing for the little energy here.
soon.
The Spiritual Disaster Demon finally absorbed enough energy and flew out of the spatial river.
Because of Xiao Ye's refining and the absorption of the Spiritual Disaster Demon, the originally quite wide river shrank by more than half. This half, without tens of thousands of years, will not be able to recover at all. It depends on luck.
The spirit disaster demon wanted to take revenge and eat Xiao Ye, but when he punched his left eye and looked around, he didn't see even a shadow of a ghost.
